results.title: Mining industry focused on creating sustainable State capacity to drive development, Joburg ...
results.description: South Africa's mining industry, which has developed infrastructure to support mines and their surrounding communities, is working with government to ensure the civil service is reformed into a capable, competent and ethical part of society. The national deficiencies dealt with through the partnership between business and government, including electricity, transport and logistics failures, can be replicated at a local scale to address the deficiencies in services in local municipalities, such as in the City of Johannesburg.
